== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from posts on the Players Committee forum. Topics used: 20536, 22883.
The cited posts are live forum.starwarsccg.org posts; they have no Internet Archive capture yet (forum snapshots are to be added later), so the refs carry no Preserved copy for now.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Isaac Vawter's differential: −29 in Michael Erisman's final standings (p316597) but −30 in his game-by-game post (p316605). The page uses −29.
* Site: the western calendar by CategoryOneGames.com (t21008 p303347) gives "WA states in Auburn"; the event announcements (p308684, p314642) give the Algona-Pacific Library in Pacific, one exit south of the SuperMall. The page uses Pacific.
* Harpster's notice of 21 June 2008 gave a 9:45 am start and named Harpster tournament director with Wirfs as assistant (p308684); Wirfs's announcement of 12 July gave 9:30 am and named Wirfs tournament director with Harpster and Erisman as additional TDs (p314642). The page uses the later announcement.
=== Left out ===
* Round-one standings (p316567) and the game-by-game results (p316605): summarized, not transcribed. They can be added as a table later.
* Jacob Vawter's own deck notes, posted as Jedi Jake (p316643: Ralltiir Ops from RS's highlander MPC list, Hidden Base Mains, Caspersen space package). The decks themselves are on the page from Erisman's final confrontation post (p316602); the handle Jedi Jake is not otherwise tied to Jacob Vawter on the wiki.
* The argument over who should have organized the event and when (p316708, French brothers): only Wirfs's factual explanation is used.
* Erisman's remark about local players who did not come (p316634); directions, phone numbers, email addresses.
* The decklist PDFs attached to p316764 (forum download ids 1033–1036, 1038–1047) are not linked; they are listed for fetching in the batch report.
* Isaac Vawter has no wiki page, so he is not linked.

== Decklist PDFs, 25 November 2026 ==
The 14 PDFs attached to p316764 were checked on the live forum: each download now returns "The selected attachment does not exist anymore." No copy was found in the Internet Archive or on res.starwarsccg.org. They are listed as not-preserved decklists on [[Mysteries]], not as a missing-attachment issue. A checked snapshot of the post is at https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start180.html.
